Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi, Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz, Finance Systems, Design, Infrastructure); none is foreign. Seeded facts quoted in prompts re-derived from seed: three jobs; Noor APP-101 has 120 messages (app_context.md:29-30); Platform Engineer Applied Greta/Ade/Marco positions 1-3 and Screen Priya/Samuel (functional prompt.md:33, hro_restart); Noor's note text 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (seed notes[0]); Lena's Product Designer unread 1 (3 messages, read_count 2, last from REC3); Noor Platform Engineer/Infrastructure/INTERVIEW=Interviewing and Product Designer/Design/APPLIED=Application received; Tomas Data Analyst/Finance Systems/SCREEN=In review (hro_candidate_view); Bill Okafor manages seeded Data Analyst so the T fallback keeps 'Bill = job manager' true; Ingrid is not Data Analyst's manager; candidate wording list matches seed candidate_status_labels. Protocol traces checked for internal consistency: B(1)-(15) card orders (V top of Applied; Y,W,X,Z,A2 after Y up two; Y,W,X below V; A2,V at Screen bottom; Z-first/V-last board-order cases in hro_bulk_all_or_none), L capacity sequence (B,E in Interview; A in Offer), Mei's expected unread in U (Bill + 3 Tomas messages), and status codes in hro_refusal_status vs hireops_rules.md:22-24 all agree. Gate scoring language matches criterion types (functional/polish binary 0, visual Likert 1). Lessons file: lesson 6 checker-not-fixer present in all five prompts; lesson 8 modifier-hold in app_context.md:33-35; lesson 9 report-every-step in the three scored prompts; lesson 13 no public address in any prompt; lesson 10 assembled sizes measured (render 4,184 B, constraints 4,868, functional 46,333, polish 13,078, visual 7,419; all under 128 KB). Minor accuracy observations (P3, not residue, no observed mis-grade): (a) functional prompt.md:47 T says 'if that address is already on J2, open a new job J3' but J3's hiring manager is never stated while T/U then call Bill 'manager of J2'/'the job's hiring manager'; the branch is effectively dead because J2 is created fresh in S and never receives Tomas's address before T. (b) functional prompt.md:51 K lists the status wording 'after each move' as 'Not moving forward, then In review, Interviewing, Offer and Hired', omitting the 'Application received' reading after the reopen to Applied; hro_candidate_view grades 'the wording follows stage changes' and the rules table is unambiguous, so a correct app is unlikely to be failed. Broken app that could pass this row: none - row 48 is about prompt text, and a sibling-residue app scenario does not apply. Conforming alternative that could fail: an app that correctly shows 'Application received' after reopen could be questioned by a literal judge under (b); considered low likelihood. This is a source review only; no judge run was used or needed for this row, and no Oracle/model/portal score is claimed.
